items.headline: Gasly's Monza miracle — a shock first-ever pole for Alpine
items.body: Pierre Gasly stunned the Temple of Speed, pipping George Russell by six-hundredths of a second to grab the first pole of his career — and the first for a French driver since Jean Alesi back in 1997. The race goes Sunday.
items.say: Did you catch Gasly nicking pole at Monza? First French pole since the '90s — nobody saw that coming.

items.headline: Bayern are flying — and today they visit a reborn Schalke
items.body: Bayern kicked off the new Bundesliga season with a 5-1 romp and roll into Gelsenkirchen on Saturday, where a promoted Schalke are back in the big time with the Veltins-Arena rocking again.
items.say: Schalke are finally back in the Bundesliga — and they drew Bayern at home first up. Brutal, right?

items.headline: Schwarbombs everywhere — Kyle Schwarber is chasing 60
items.body: Philly's slugger was the first to 40 homers this year and hasn't cooled off one bit, headlining a wild National League long-ball race as the Phillies barrel toward October.
items.say: You seeing what Schwarber's doing? Dude might actually run down 60 home runs.

items.headline: College football at Lambeau — Notre Dame hits the frozen tundra
items.body: Notre Dame takes its Shamrock Series to Lambeau Field on Sunday to face Wisconsin — the Irish's first-ever game at the Packers' iconic home, and only the third college game the storied stadium has ever hosted.
items.say: Notre Dame's playing at Lambeau this weekend — reckon anyone tries a Lambeau Leap?

items.headline: Beyoncé reopens 'B'Day' at 20 — with a Selena duet
items.body: For her birthday, Beyoncé dropped a 20th-anniversary deluxe of 'B'Day' stuffed with unreleased tracks — including a posthumous 'Irreemplazable (Como La Flor)' duet with Selena Quintanilla that had fans in their feelings.
items.say: Beyoncé put out a Selena duet for the B'Day reissue — a 'Como La Flor' mashup. Total chills.

items.headline: Miley's back on the dance floor — 'Bass Persuades' opens a new era
items.body: Miley Cyrus dropped the sultry title track and video for her tenth album 'Bass Persuades' (out Sept. 18) — a smoky, bass-heavy nightclub romp that has her fully in dance-pop mode.
items.say: New Miley single 'Bass Persuades' — very late-night dance floor energy. You into it?

items.headline: 'The Grand Tour' is back — with a brand-new trio behind the wheel
items.body: Prime Video's petrolhead epic returns with a fresh set of hosts tearing across deserts and airfields (with ex-F1 champ Jenson Button dropping by for the mayhem). New crew, same very-bad-ideas spirit.
items.say: The Grand Tour rebooted with all-new hosts — curious if it still has the magic. You gonna watch?

items.headline: Spidey just won't leave No. 1 — six straight weekends on top
items.body: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' won Labor Day weekend for its sixth consecutive week atop the box office — the longest #1 streak since 'Avatar: The Way of Water' in 2022, and now it's creeping up on an all-time domestic record.
items.say: Spider-Man's been No. 1 six weekends in a row — haven't seen a run like that since Avatar 2.
